rows.title: MORE ARTICLES FOR READING, LISTENING, AND SPEAKING PRACTICE
rows.body:
In this folder you will find 24 articles for listening, reading, and speaking practice. 
Our advice is to highlight the text and listen to article using Microsoft's Text-to-Speech feature (we have the instructions in the folder).
Listen to the article to improve your ability to hear spoken English. Then read the article out loud and work on your pronunciation. Highlight and listen to the article a few sentences at a time, and read those sentences out loud to improve your pronunciation.

rows.title: PRACTICE READING / WRITING EXAM
rows.body:
In this folder, you can find three articles from The Conversation. 
To take a mock Reading / Writing exam, please follow the instructions below.
The total exam time is two and a half hours. You may NOT use a dictionary.
Task 1. Read the article. Summarize each scholar’s ideas in your own words. The summary should be about 100 words.
Task 2. Write a response essay (400-500 words) on this material. You may respond to any viewpoint(s) in the material or the topic in general. Please include at least one direct quotation and one paraphrase in your essay with correct APA in-text citation. Please also include an APA reference entry for the material, although it will not be graded along with the rest of the paper.

ann.title: Notes on Individual Presentation
ann.body:
The Individual Presentation will start from 4/5 Dec. For this assessment, please choose one article OR one video as the material. The material should be chosen from the course materials and should not be the same as your practice presentation. The format of the presentation is a Summary AND Response talk (4-5 mins), plus a Q & A session (1 min). Make sure to make the summary brief, preferably to be completed within 2 minutes; the summary only needs to cover the main points of the material chosen. 
Please upload your slides to the Individual Presentation folder, if you choose to use the classroom computer. Otherwise, you need to bring your own device (HDMI connection is required). 
There's no need to dress business formal, but sportswear should be avoided. Only students scheduled to present are required to come to class (on time); those not scheduled don't have to come. 
Thank you for your attention.
p.s.
Don't read for your presentation.
